en: Looking closer, you have a face so expressive
I'd like to use you as a model.
As long as you don't disturb my painting,
feel free to come and go.
You'd better leave before I call the police.
Say, would you really be willing to model
for my paintings?
<Maybe I'll give it a try>
note: Answer choice to msg 317038; no used_in.

en: <I'll have to decline>
note: Answer choice to msg 317038; no used_in.

en: Oh, please do!
I can't pay a big modeling fee, but
I'll paint a fine picture, you'll see.
I see... What a shame.
Your orders?
For you, I would do anything.
Lately, I can't keep my mind on my work...
I almost feel I'm the one who needs nursing...
Give me your orders...
note: Follows '{NAME}, my master...' (#0) on a new line.

en: How strange...
Lately, every now and then,
I find I've forgotten all about him...
It's a lovely morning, isn't it?
How is your work going?
I hope you get good results.
Um... you must be tired after a long day.
How was your day?
Knowing I'll get to have dinner with Darrell
again tonight makes me all giddy.
Though it's only natural, since we're married.
Yes? Who might you be?
I'm Samantha.
Um, are you an acquaintance of Darrell's...
my husband's?
No, I have only just arrived here, so
I thought I would pay my respects.
Oh, I see. How kind of you.
I work as a nurse at the hospital,
so if anything happens, please come by.
Now, if you'll excuse me.
note: Spoken by Samantha (320384/320813) and by the player (332584, 385853).

en: We've only just gotten married.
So, um...
Heh, I see.
It seems I have intruded.
Do you really understand?
! Come in.
You're always welcome here.
Why don't we have a meal together?
With Darrell too, of course.
Yes? Um, are you feeling unwell?
No, nothing of the kind.
I was nearby and thought to pay a brief call,
that is all.
I'm Samantha, the nurse.
You should probably greet the doctor.
When there are no patients, that is.
Yes, ah, um...
wasn't it?
Are you feeling unwell?
I was nearby and thought to look in briefly,
I see. This isn't really a place for healthy
people, so please don't stay long.
note: Ends the sentence: next row #2656 is ''.

en: Come to think of it, you do look rather pale.
Would you like a checkup?
Are you feeling unwell today?
Or maybe you've come to lend us
a hand, perhaps?
You come by often, don't you?
Is there something here that you like?
Please do come to our house again.
Being alone with Darrell is nice, but
talking with you would be fun too.
I'm sure Darrell would like you too.
I love my husband.
But I have to share some of my love
with my patients too, you know.
Ah, my love knows no bounds.
Pleased to meet you, ma'am.
Um, are you a friend of Darrell's...
No, I've only just come here, so
I thought I'd stop by to say hello.
